title: International Shopify Routing Strategy
summary: Gurveen Kaur Bagga and Aditya Patel evaluated whether Shopify routing rules and additional fulfillment locations are needed outside the United States, focusing on Berlin, Paris, and Canada. Aditya recommended using the simplest Shopify-to-NetSuite flow where Shopify routing functions correctly, avoiding additional locations or routing unless fulfillment requirements or inventory synchronization create a need. Canadian order volume may increase during the Labour Day sale, potentially justifying additional configuration. It also remains unresolved whether non-U.S. countries can use the standard Shopify-to-NetSuite flow without routing or more complex inventory synchronization.
